alternatives.name: MCP Inspector
alternatives.why_not_default: Native stdio invocation computed 42, establishing a narrow protocol operation. It does not establish application behavior, client hooks, project scope or failure coverage.

alternatives.name: ShellCheck
alternatives.why_not_default: The referenced decision summarizes scoped native shell acceptance without a concrete ShellCheck finding or returned command result. Useful for shell changes, but insufficient as the general behavioral default.

alternatives.name: TypeSafe semantic skill
alternatives.why_not_default: Eight provider judgments matched 7/8 frozen labels versus 3/8 for weak containment. C4 remained wrong and Promptfoo exit 100 was preserved. This supports advisory semantic checks, without representative accuracy or a matched native-review comparison.

alternatives.name: Difftastic
alternatives.why_not_default: The referenced decision summarizes structural comparison acceptance, without a concrete behavioral oracle or returned diff. Structural review complements execution but cannot establish changed runtime behavior.

alternatives.name: Official OpenAI CI and security skills
alternatives.why_not_default: The CI helper returned a clean-check result independently corroborated by five successful checks, but failing-log recovery and repair remain unqualified. Security guidance has installation/discovery evidence without measured findings or false-positive controls; the combined candidate therefore remains source-review strength.

alternatives.name: MLflow
alternatives.why_not_default: The entry explicitly records no executed tracking server or experiment. Artifact lineage could complement evaluation, but retained evidence does not demonstrate behavioral verification or failure inspection.

limits: Reviewed retained public evidence only; no fresh evaluation, browser run or upstream-version verification was performed.
Private browser/build logs, original-host state and unpublished failure captures were not inspected; public receipts describe those observations.
ShellCheck and Difftastic evidence was limited to relevant catalog decision sections, so their native execution summaries were not independently verified.
open_gaps: No representative held-out model-quality evaluation or matched comparison establishes universal superiority.
The four-query retrieval assertion is locally authored and evaluates rounded upstream output; direct evaluation token usage and cost are unreported.
Playwright acceptance covers a local synthetic ledger application, with no production authentication, load, external ingestion or independent-host restore qualification.
Inspect AI execution, MLflow experiment tracking, CI failure repair and security finding quality remain unestablished by the reviewed evidence.
TypeSafe's C4 disagreement and unmatched native-review baseline remain unresolved qualification boundaries.

arms: Current Promptfoo lane versus Inspect AI using identical frozen catalog cases, provider responses and deterministic scoring.
Current Playwright ledger workflow versus a proposed replacement using identical application inputs and independent API/database observations.
overturn_protocol.metric: Compare frozen-oracle agreement, false passes, retained failure details and independently corroborated state. Replace a selected tool only after an executed comparison closes a concrete coverage or failure-inspection gap without losing existing checks.

overturn_when: Overturn after an executed matched comparison on blueprints/native-skill-practice/catalog-cases.json demonstrates that Inspect AI closes an evaluation or failure-inspection gap in Promptfoo, or a replacement exercises blueprints/convergence-practice/application-delivery/browser/ledger.spec.ts and the restart checks in blueprints/convergence-practice/wsl-application/README.md with better independently verified coverage and no lost assertions. Lane agreement alone is insufficient.
why_selected: Select Promptfoo and Playwright for complementary evaluation and application checks. Native Promptfoo output in evidence/artifacts/promptfoo-nemotron-upstream-20260921/results.public.json contains the returned matrix with all four published query/document pairs ranked first; its qualification.json records separate model-metric observations and retained browser failures. This is upstream-example execution through a local integration, not held-out quality proof. blueprints/native-skill-practice/typesafe-result.json also preserves a failing evaluation with exit 100. For Playwright, blueprints/convergence-practice/wsl-application/receipt.json records the unchanged browser create/update/reload test passing with zero retries, separate API/database persistence observations across restart, and failed setup/recovery attempts. The inspected browser/ledger.spec.ts confirms the actual assertions. These project checks provide the strongest complementary retained evidence for the requirement; their combined classification is local integration.
